description: The comment cites RFC 4518 §2.1 and RFC 5280 §7.1. These citations let reviewers and v0.2 implementers verify claims independently. Example: 'RFC 5280 §7.1 classifies TeletexString support as OPTIONAL' is verifiable; 'TeletexString is rarely used' is not. RFC citations are a sign of rigor, not over-documentation. Worth keeping and using as a model for other comments.
title: DECISION: RFC citations in doc comment enable independent verification
